title: Graph Algorithms
description: Model roads, networks and dependencies as graphs, then explore them with BFS and DFS, order tasks with topological sort, and find the fastest route with Dijkstra's algorithm.

chapters.title: Foundations
chapters.description: The vocabulary of vertices and edges, and the data structures that store a graph in memory.

chapters.title: Traversal
chapters.description: Visit every vertex systematically, layer by layer or branch by branch, and put dependencies in order.

chapters.title: Shortest Paths
chapters.description: Find the cheapest route through a weighted graph with a greedy strategy and a priority queue.
